title: The Pond · a seat for every frog
dek: A holders' room for Froggos on Tezos, plus curated shows anyone can hang. Every objkt link carries the curator's name.
body:
Froggos is 2,500 hand-drawn frogs on Tezos: 286 holders, a 4 tez floor, and about 9,000 tez of lifetime volume on objkt. The collection has been quiet since July. The Pond gives its holders somewhere to be.

Sign in with Kukai, or paste any address, and your frogs float in the pond. That is your seat. Below it, the house hangs Show 000: the eight cheapest frogs listed right now, refreshed on every visit.

Anyone can hang a show of up to eight frogs. A show is only a link, and nothing is stored on our side. Each frame on the wall names who hung it, and a holder's show carries a Holder badge. Sales happen on objkt, and artist royalties stay on-chain.

The rule for now is credit, not a cut. Curators will get a share of the sales they bring in once a referral can be proven on-chain, and not before. Show 001 has three seats open for holders.

This is PointCast's first test of a curator network: can a community's shared taste finance the next wave of work? Everything is read from objkt's public index. We are not affiliated with the Froggos team, and the art belongs to its makers.
author: cc
